methodologyNotes: Products were selected as 12 notable true-wireless earbuds a buyer compares in 2026, spanning flagship ANC, prosumer, and mid-tier segments. Seeds provided in the brief were verified and expanded. Apple AirPods Pro 3 confirmed released September 2025; AirPods 4 covers the ANC variant at $179. Sony WF-1000XM5 released June 2023. Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds: the 2nd-generation model (July 2025) is the current in-market version and is included rather than the 2023 original. Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro released July 2024. Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 released September 2024. Nothing Ear refers to the 2024 model (Nothing Ear (2024), released April 2024 at $149) — an earlier draft mislabeled it as a non-existent '2025' model at $109; corrected. Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 4 released March 2024 (US MSRP $299.95; an earlier draft over-estimated $350 from the UK price; corrected). Additional products added for coverage: AirPods 4 (ANC model), Samsung Galaxy Buds 3, and Jabra Evolve2 Buds. Primary sources were manufacturer spec pages (apple.com/airpods-pro/specs/, samsung.com/us/mobile-audio/galaxy-buds3-pro/, us.nothing.tech/products/ear, bose.com). Corroboration via specialist review sites (9to5google.com, digitaltrends.com, headphonecheck.com, expertreviews.co.uk). Many large sites (sony.com electronics.sony.com, gsmarena.com, rtings.com, cnet.com, theverge.com, pcmag.com, best-buy.com, bhphotovideo.com) blocked automated access (429, 403, or site-level block). specKeys: anc (bool), driver_mm (numeric, driver diameter in mm; null if not publicly stated), battery_buds_hr (numeric, rated earbud-only playtime at ANC-on where available, else rated maximum; null if unconfirmed), battery_case_hr (numeric, total playback hours including case charges at ANC-on; null if unconfirmed), bluetooth (string, version), ip_rating (string, stated IP/IPX class; null if not rated), wireless_charging (bool, whether the case supports wireless charging), codecs (string, comma-separated supported BT audio codecs), weight_per_bud_g (numeric, single earbud mass in grams; null if not confirmed), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). battery_buds_hr and battery_case_hr use ANC-on figures where available. priceUsd is the US launch MSRP in USD; null where no primary-source confirmation was achievable. accessedAt is 2026-06-15 on all entries. Adversarial note: Apple does not publish driver sizes or codec details beyond AAC+SBC for AirPods; those fields are null for Apple products. Samsung Galaxy Buds 3 Pro driver is a dual-driver (10.5mm dynamic + 6.1mm planar) per makeuseof.com review; listed as 10.5 (dominant woofer) with a note. Nothing Ear (2024) uses an 11mm dynamic driver with ceramic diaphragm (confirmed via SoundGuys/search). Verifier corrections (2026-06-15): Sony XM5 weight 5.9g added; Bose QC Ultra 2nd-Gen case battery 18→24h, weight 7.2→7.3g, release 2025-07→2025-06, source URL fixed to QCUE2; Samsung Buds3 Pro weight 5.4g added; Pixel Buds Pro 2 codecs LC3 removed (SBC+AAC only); Nothing Ear relabeled 2024 ($149, was bogus 2025/$109), driver 11mm, weight 4.6g, case 24h; Sennheiser MTW4 price $350→$300 ($299.95); Jabra Evolve2 Buds price $449→$349, battery 7/23→8/33h, release 2022-11.
